summary.short: Chilean decree setting air-pollutant emission limits for new compression-ignition generator sets of 19 kW or more, applying nationwide. Requires pre-import documentary verification, annual owner reporting, sales reporting by manufacturers and importers, and customs data sharing, supervised by the Superintendencia del Medio Ambiente. Takes effect on publication.
summary.long: Decree No. 38 of 2020 sets national exhaust-emission limits (g/kWh) for new generator sets with compression-ignition engines and maximum engine power of 19 kW or more, applicable throughout Chile (Arts. 1, 4-7). Units supplying residential customers in areas without access to the national electrical system are excluded (Art. 2). Limits vary by power band and engine displacement; those for 130 kW and above apply to units imported from 15 September 2028 (Arts. 6-7, as amended in 2025). Manufacturers, representatives, distributors and importers must submit compliance documentation to the Superintendencia del Medio Ambiente before import; the verified documentation supports customs clearance (Art. 8). New units need a sealed, non-resettable hour meter, and owners of units of 19 kW or more report annually through the RETC single-window system (Art. 9). Sales reporting to the Superintendencia starts 36 months after entry into force (Art. 10); Customs reports monthly imports from 24 months (Art. 11). Protocols are due within 6 months (Art. 13). Supervision falls to the Superintendencia under Law 20.417 (Art. 12). The decree takes effect on publication (Art. 14); no penalty amounts appear in the text.

notes: Text as provided: Tables 1 to 6 (emission limit values) are referenced but do not appear in the document, so no limit values are coded. Arts. 6 and 7 contain marginal markers (Decreto 26, Art. único N° 1 and N° 2, D.O. 25.09.2025) that appear to record an amendment; the amended dates are from 15 September 2028. Arts. 4 (19 kW to under 560 kW) and 6 (130 kW to under 560 kW) overlap in range. Art. 3 f describes the power factor as the energy an equipment converts into useful work and gives 0.8 as the typical kVA-to-kW value. The text of Art. 5 ends with a stray fragment ('ARTICULO 5 - 0>'). Art. 3 h and i tie new and existing units to importation dates counted from 24 months after entry into force; Arts. 10 and 13 use 36 and 6 months respectively.
